surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. Decomposition of chemisorbed TEMAH ligands and reaction with decomposed surface sites during parasitic growth. Hydrolysis of chemisorbed Hf(NCH3C2H5)x species through ligand exchange. Dehydroxylation of OH sites during extended H2O pulses.
evidence: The text describes the ligand exchange reaction between TEMAH and surface hydroxyl groups, the decomposition of chemisorbed TEMAH ligands, and the hydrolysis of chemisorbed Hf(NCH3C2H5)x species. It also mentions dehydroxylation of OH sites during extended H2O pulses. The reaction equations and intermediate species are explicitly discussed in the context of the ALD process.
